title: Capability Contract Envelope — draft 0.1.0
description: Signed wrapper around a capability contract (ADR-0001 §2.5, D9). The contract body is untouched; who vouches for it lives here. Signed content is RFC 8785 JCS(contract) only. Signature objects reuse the three fields of A2A 1.0 AgentCardSignature verbatim (RFC 7515 JWS, flattened). Unlike A2A card signatures (multiple = key rotation), multiple signatures here mean multiple endorsers, and every signature present must verify.

contract.description: The capability contract exactly as signed. Validated against the contract schema plus its cross-field rules; the envelope never relaxes the contract gate.

contract_hash.description: "sha256:" + lowercase hex SHA-256 of JCS(contract). This is the value an Agent Card references in capabilities.extensions[].params.contract_hash; the validator recomputes and compares it.

signatures.description: One entry per endorser (self-declared = publisher key; tested = tester key; certified = certifier key). Endorsement level is derived by L4 from the signer identity (kid / jku against a trusted key store), never carried in the payload.

signature.description: A2A 1.0 AgentCardSignature shape. Protected header MUST carry alg (ES256 / RS256 / EdDSA; 'none' is rejected by the validator), typ = "JOSE", and kid; MAY carry jku.

header.description: Unprotected JWS header, not covered by the signature
